summary: Proposal to add GNAP (Git-Native Agent Protocol) integration for coordinating autonomous AI agents with Temporal workflows. The proposal suggests using GNAP as a complementary pattern for less-structured autonomous work, with Temporal workflows delegating tasks to git-based task boards managed by agents.
userImpact: Users cannot use native SDK support for integrating Temporal with autonomous AI agents using GNAP, requiring manual workarounds for this coordination pattern.
proposedFix: Add GNAP integration support to enable Temporal workflows to natively delegate autonomous agent work to GNAP-based task boards.
workaround: Users can integrate GNAP through standard activities without SDK-level support, implementing the pattern manually.
resolutionDetails: Maintainers closed the issue because the proposal does not involve nontrivial integration with the Temporal SDK. They suggested exploring the AI Partner Program instead.
keyQuote: I'm going to close this since there's no detail on how this would actually involve nontrivial integration with Temporal.
